# User directory lookup

`lookup_user` accepts a user identifier with surrounding whitespace and in any letter case. Identifiers are normalized by trimming whitespace and applying Unicode case folding before lookup.

The lookup cache stores normalized keys and must not change the lookup semantics. Unknown identifiers return `None`.
